paragraphs: Rabbi Dosa ben Tevet: Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:8.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Shir HaShirim Rabbah7:8 explicitly has Rabbi Dosa bar Tevet. It supports Rabbi for this occurrence, while Hyman's supplied ben is retained separately from the witness's bar; Tevet remains untitled.
